text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: KV paging regression detected on prod (us-west-2). Large spike in kv_block_store.bytes and block_manager.evictions starting ~14:22 UTC. Automated alert triggered for high eviction churn and token-latency cliffs.

raj: I'm looking at the dashboards now — continuous-batching window jumped from ~12ms to >200ms and KV block size grew ~5x. Seeing sustained KV meta allocations, looks like metadata isn't being reclaimed fast enough.

emma: Observed 95p token latency for model-g1 up from 220ms -> 1.1s, and a few 502s for requests routed to dedicated pool-23. Any customers flagged?

maria: ACME (dedicated cluster) and BetaAnalytics (hosted) show elevated errors in error-rail. ACME is reporting timeouts. I'm on customer chat.

lee: Possible quick mitigation: reduce continuous batching window and disable prefix cache for affected model to avoid huge per-request KV growth. We should also consider tuning `kv_block_size_target` down temporarily and bump eviction aggressiveness.

raj: Agreed. Proposing hotfix steps:
1) set `continuous_batching.max_window=32ms` on pool-23
2) set `kv.block_manager.target_block_bytes=8MB` (was 32MB)
3) enable eviction logging and a soft-shed when kv_block_growth_rate > 0.2/s

raj: Applying step 1 now via control plane:```bash
redwoodctl pool update pool-23 --set continuous_batching.max_window=32ms --reason "kv paging regression hotfix"
```

deploy-bot: rollout started: pool-23 config update (6 nodes) — 0/6 done

emma: kicking off disable of prefix cache for model-g1 in hosted route to reduce cache amplification. Command:```json
{
  "model": "g1",
  "route": "hosted-default",
  "prefix_cache": false
}
```

maria: Noted. I'm posting to ACME that we're applying mitigations and will follow up after stabilization. cc @support-team :thumbsup:

raj: Rollout progress: 3/6 nodes updated. Eviction rate trending down but still elevated; block manager metadata count decreased ~30% after first node updated.

lee: Can we avoid a full restart? If metadata leaks are only per-instance, draining the node should help. Use `redwoodctl node drain --grace 30s` then restart process to reclaim memory.

raj: Doing a rolling drain+restart on one node now.```bash
redwoodctl node drain ip-10-0-22-11 --grace 30s && redwoodctl node restart ip-10-0-22-11
```

emma: Handoff note — I'm taking on-call for the next 30m to observe customer impact and coordinate outreach. Raj, leave any in-flight commands in the runbook.

raj: Added runbook section "kv-paging-hotfix-1772345678" with commands and rollback steps. Also logging the exact config diff.

maria: Customer update: ACME acknowledges mitigations, reduced timeouts but still seeing a few 502s. BetaAnalytics error rate cut in half. I'll follow up with dedicated support thread and include postmortem invite.

lee: After hotfix completes, we should revert `kv.block_manager.target_block_bytes` back to default and instead implement a dynamic cap that responds to key cardinality. Creating GH issue: "block-manager: dynamic target block bytes & eviction hysteresis".

raj: Rollout finished: deploy-bot reports 6/6 nodes updated. Metrics: kv_block_size peak down ~4x from high-water, 95p token latency for model-g1 down to ~260ms within ~6 minutes of full rollout. Error rate at request-level back to baseline for hosted routes; ACME still monitoring for dedicated route but trending down.

emma: Confirmed stabilization on my watch. No further customer escalations for now. I'll keep the incident active for correlation and followup tasks.

maria: Creating summary ticket and customer-facing notes. Assigning postmortem to eng-runtime + eng-ml for deep root-cause (likely interaction between continuous-batching heuristics and block sizing under certain sequence-length skew).

lee: Followups we need to track: automated guardrail that auto-sheds batching when `kv_block_growth_rate` exceeds threshold, better observability on block-manager metadata (per-model breakdown), and a canary test for continuous-batching changes.

raj: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-324. Labels: sev-2, paging, kv-cache, continuous-batching. Postmortem due in 72h.

emma: Marking this for handoff notes: all mitigations applied; rollback plan available in runbook; outreach started. If anyone sees regression spike, please ping @emma and escalate. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident updated: state=mitigated, severity=degraded, assignees=[eng-runtime], incident_id=INC-2026-324

raj: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up on the GH issue and instrument additional metrics for block-manager. Good catch on rapid batching window growth — that was the immediate trigger.

maria: I'll close the customer-facing update once ACME confirms stable.

lee: Filing the tuning playbook PR now.

emma: Handoff complete. Leaving this thread open for any residual notes.

deploy-bot: log: config-change rollout completed by raj at 14:30 UTC.

incident-bot: Note: please attach logs/snapshots to INC-2026-324 and assign postmortem owner when ready.
